_doc: Combat targets (M4, GPT's v1.2 decisions): what each target is and what it resists, explicit in the data so a skill asks the target instead of guessing. size: small | fixed. pullable: the Phantom Chain captures it and Chain Pull can drag it; launchable: Rising Slash can launch it. A target that resists either takes the damage and a short stagger instead (stagger, s, at most 0.3). capture: the chain's hold and its diminishing returns — a capture within reset s of the previous one lasts the next factor of the full hold; past the last factor the target is immune until reset s after its last capture. juggle: after max_hits aerial follow-ups or max_time s in the air, whichever comes first, it cannot be launched again until it is back on its feet. down: s lying after a launch's landing; getup: s to rise; defeat_reset: s from defeat until it rises again whole; return_after: s without a blow before it walks back to its mark (when moved more than 1 m from it). The timings marked provisional in the M4 report await GPT's review.
